blocks.html: CoolSculpting® is the most innovative, non-surgical way to lose stubborn fat. The CoolSculpting® technology targets and cools unwanted fat cells to provide a natural-looking reduction in fat bulges. Unlike many other procedures that promise fat reduction, CoolSculpting® involves no needles, surgery, or inconvenient downtime. Many patients can enjoy browsing the web on their laptop, using their cell phone, or even reading a booking during the procedure.

CoolSculpting® is safe and is approved by the FDA. What is great about CoolSculpting® is that the results are incredible and look natural. Some patients can even see results as early as 3 weeks, but typically the most dramatic results occur 2-3 months after the procedure.

blocks.text: How Many CoolSculpting® Treatments Will I Need?

blocks.html: Many patients are satisfied after one treatment; however some patients prefer 2 treatments to achieve the best results. Your treatment plan can be discussed at your complementary consultation.

blocks.text: What Happens During a CoolSculpting® Treatment?

blocks.html: A cool gel-like cloth is placed on the area that is being treated in order to properly dress the skin for treatment. Then, a device is placed on your body that will draw the bulge of your fat up between two cooling panels. The process takes about 35 minutes depending on your needs, then our technicians will massage the treated area after the procedure for approximately 2 minutes.

blocks.text: How Soon Can I Return to Normal Activities After My CoolSculpting® Treatment?

blocks.html: Since CoolSculpting® is non-surgical, many patients return to work after their session. Some patients make experience redness, minor bruising, tingling, numbness, or minor discomfort in the treated area, however this is only temporary and will resolve.
Yes, as long as you maintain a healthy lifestyle, long-term results should remain stable.
